::: {#rem-cross-entropy-takes-logits}

#### Why PyTorch's cross-entropy takes logits

`nn.CrossEntropyLoss` and `nn.functional.cross_entropy` take [logits](#def-logits), not probabilities.
They compute the log probabilities by @thm-log-softmax, with the shift of @thm-shift-lse,
so the loss stays finite for any logits.
A classification network built for them ends with a linear layer and no softmax:
softmax is applied only when probabilities are wanted for their own sake,
as in @sol-scores-to-probabilities.
Putting `nn.Softmax` at the end of the network and then calling `nn.CrossEntropyLoss` applies softmax twice.

:::
